name: fleet-live
description: Live dashboard for a simulated vehicle fleet

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck -w api && npm test && npm run test:web && npm run lint && npm run build
